verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no account-level data export or offboarding capability for Browserbase. The Downloads API only retrieves files that a browser session downloaded. URL-to-HTML/JSON/markdown conversion is a web-fetch feature for agents, not an export of the user's own data. Neither is evidence that a user can export all their data in open formats and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
